items.title: Nanopore sequencing combined with adaptive sampling and NanoExpansion enables accurate characterization of repeat expansion disorders.
items.summary: Expansion repeat disorders are caused by abnormal expansions of short tandem repeats (STRs). We evaluated targeted long-read nanopore sequencing for comprehensive characterization of STR expansions in 132 participants, including patients with myotonic dystrophy type 1 (DM1, n = 51) and DM2 ( n = 3) already characterized by Southern blot, C9orf72 -associated amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS n = 11) evaluated by repeat primed polymerase chain reaction (RP-PCR; validation group), suspected spinocerebellar ataxia (SCA, n = 46), cerebellar ataxia with neuropathy and vestibular areflexia syndrome (CANVAS; n = 13), Huntington's disease (1), Kennedy disease (1), Friedreich ataxia (FRDA, 2), and 4 healthy controls (test group). Native DNA was sequenced using adaptive sampling (AS) on Oxford Nanopore GridION or PromethION-2Solo platforms. Long-PCR sequencing was performed for comparison. We also developed NanoExpansion, a Python-based tool for sizing expanded alleles and detecting sequence interruptions. We correctly characterized all DM1, DM2, ALS, FRDA, Huntington's disease, and Kennedy disease cases, and identified eight SCA27B, two SCA37, three SCA31, one SCA3, and nine CANVAS cases. Compared with the AS approach, long-PCR underestimated alleles exceeding 800 repeats. Repeat interruptions were detected in 27/51 (52.9%) DM1 cases and 1/10 (10%) ALS, but not in CANVAS, FRDA, Huntington's disease, Kennedy disease, or SCA cases. This integrated sequencing analysis pipeline provides accurate, comprehensive characterization of repeat expansion disorders and has the potential to improve routine genetic diagnosis.
items.titleZh: 纳米孔测序结合自适应采样与NanoExpansion可准确表征重复扩增疾病
items.summaryZh: 该研究评估了纳米孔长读长测序结合自适应采样和自研工具NanoExpansion，在132名参与者中准确表征多种重复扩增疾病，包括C9orf72相关ALS。结果显示该方法能正确识别所有ALS病例，并检测到重复序列中断，而传统长PCR会低估超长扩增。
items.insight: 该研究为C9orf72相关ALS及其他重复扩增疾病的遗传诊断提供了更准确的长读长测序方案，NanoExpansion工具可检测重复中断，有助于理解重复扩增的结构异质性与疾病表型的关系，值得ALS遗传研究者关注。

items.abstractZh: 重复扩增疾病由短串联重复序列（STR）的异常扩增引起。我们评估了靶向长读长纳米孔测序在132名参与者中对STR扩增的全面表征能力，包括已通过Southern blot表征的强直性肌营养不良1型（DM1，n=51）和DM2（n=3）患者、通过重复引物聚合酶链反应（RP-PCR）评估的C9orf72相关肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS，n=11；验证组）、疑似脊髓小脑共济失调（SCA，n=46）、小脑共济失调伴神经病和前庭反射消失综合征（CANVAS，n=13）、亨廷顿病（1例）、肯尼迪病（1例）、弗里德赖希共济失调（FRDA，2例）以及4名健康对照（测试组）。使用Oxford Nanopore GridION或PromethION-2Solo平台上的自适应采样（AS）对天然DNA进行测序。同时进行长PCR测序以作比较。我们还开发了NanoExpansion，一种基于Python的工具，用于确定扩增等位基因的大小并检测序列中断。我们正确表征了所有DM1、DM2、ALS、FRDA、亨廷顿病和肯尼迪病病例，并识别出8例SCA27B、2例SCA37、3例SCA31、1例SCA3和9例CANVAS病例。与AS方法相比，长PCR低估了超过800个重复的等位基因。在27/51（52.9%）的DM1病例和1/10（10%）的ALS中检测到重复中断，但在CANVAS、FRDA、亨廷顿病、肯尼迪病或SCA病例中未检测到。这种整合测序分析流程可对重复扩增疾病进行准确、全面的表征，并具有改善常规遗传诊断的潜力。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究近期将纳米孔自适应采样与NanoExpansion工具整合，提升了C9orf72相关ALS等重复扩增疾病的遗传诊断准确性，具有转化价值。

items.title: Dysfunction of the blood-brain barrier and neurovascular unit in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis - From advanced human models to treatments.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disorder, characterized by the degeneration of motor neurons, resulting in progressive and eventually complete loss of motor function. The phenotypical heterogeneity of ALS poses a challenge to early diagnosis and treatment, with currently available therapeutics only capable of relieving symptoms and slowing progression. While ALS is classified as a motor neuron disease (MND), research has identified significant impairment to the blood-brain barrier (BBB) and neurovascular unit (NVU) of ALS patients. The BBB along with supporting cells of the NVU selectively control the entry of substances into the central nervous system (CNS) and maintain brain homeostasis, with its many cellular components demonstrating impaired function, specifically relating to inflammation, oxidative stress and TDP-43 proteinopathy. The advent of more advanced in vitro techniques as well as use of patient-derived BBB cells has presented a promising alternative to recreate the in vivo structure of the BBB/NVU in a highly controlled platform. Such approaches have ranged from simple 2-dimensional (2D) cell culture to intricate 3-dimensional (3D) co-culture systems, as well as microfluidic systems and organoids, with a potential to investigate ALS associated BBB/NVU dysfunction and drug discovery. This review provides a comprehensive assessment of known BBB/NVU dysfunction in ALS and methods of investigating this using in vitro and in vivo platforms with a focus on inflammation, oxidative stress and pathological TDP-43 expression. This review also presents a future perspective to overcoming barriers to treatment of ALS using new patient-derived BBB/NVU model systems.
items.titleZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化中血脑屏障与神经血管单元的功能障碍——从先进人类模型到治疗
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇综述，系统梳理了ALS中血脑屏障和神经血管单元的功能障碍，重点涉及炎症、氧化应激和TDP-43蛋白病变。文章还总结了从2D培养到3D共培养、微流控和类器官等体外模型，以及患者来源BBB细胞在研究和药物发现中的应用，并展望了基于患者来源模型克服治疗障碍的前景。
items.insight: 该综述将ALS的病理视野从运动神经元扩展到血脑屏障和神经血管单元，并系统盘点了患者来源BBB/NVU模型这一新兴工具链。对ALS研究者而言，其价值在于：一方面提示BBB/NVU功能障碍可能是被低估的疾病机制和治疗靶点；另一方面，患者来源模型有望弥补传统动物模型在人类遗传背景和屏障功能上的不足，为药物筛选和转化研究提供更贴近临床的平台。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种致命的神经退行性疾病，以运动神经元变性为特征，导致运动功能进行性且最终完全丧失。ALS的表型异质性给早期诊断和治疗带来挑战，目前可用的治疗手段仅能缓解症状并延缓进展。尽管ALS被归类为运动神经元病（MND），研究已发现ALS患者的血脑屏障（BBB）和神经血管单元（NVU）存在显著损伤。BBB连同NVU的支持细胞选择性控制物质进入中枢神经系统（CNS）并维持脑稳态，其多种细胞成分表现出功能受损，具体涉及炎症、氧化应激和TDP-43蛋白病变。更先进的体外技术以及患者来源BBB细胞的应用，为在高度可控的平台上重建BBB/NVU的体内结构提供了有前景的替代方案。此类方法从简单的二维（2D）细胞培养到复杂的三维（3D）共培养系统，以及微流控系统和类器官，具有研究ALS相关BBB/NVU功能障碍和药物发现的潜力。本综述全面评估了ALS中已知的BBB/NVU功能障碍，以及利用体外和体内平台研究这一问题的方法，重点关注炎症、氧化应激和病理性TDP-43表达。本综述还提出了利用新的患者来源BBB/NVU模型系统克服ALS治疗障碍的未来展望。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述聚焦ALS中血脑屏障与神经血管单元功能障碍这一新近受到关注的方向，并系统评估患者来源先进模型在机制研究和药物发现中的转化价值。

items.title: Exploring the toxicological impact of BDE-209 on neurodegenerative diseases through network toxicology, molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulation and in-vitro study.
items.summary: Decabromodiphenyl ether (BDE-209) is a persistent flame retardant associated with neurotoxicity, but its potential links to neurodegenerative diseases remain unclear. We integrated network toxicology, molecular docking, molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, and in vitro experiments to investigate BDE-209 in Parkinson's disease (PD), Alzheimer's disease (AD), and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). Network analysis identified 90 shared targets, enriched in lipid metabolism, oxidative stress, and inflammatory pathways, including IL-17 and TNF signaling. Docking prioritized the FKBP12-mTOR complex as a candidate binding system, with a score of -8.6 kcal/mol. MD simulations supported the stability of the predicted pose, which was dominated by van der Waals and hydrophobic interactions involving PHE-128 and TRP-190. In differentiated PC12 cells, BDE-209 increased p-mTOR at 10 μM and IL-1β at 20 μM without overt cytotoxicity. Rapamycin attenuated the p-mTOR response, supporting mTOR involvement, although mTOR dependence of IL-1β induction was not established. At 40 μM, BDE-209 reduced viability, potentially confounded by precipitation or aggregation. These findings implicate mTOR dysregulation in BDE-209 cellular responses, but direct binding, chronic exposure, and in vivo disease relevance require further validation.
items.titleZh: 通过网络毒理学、分子对接、分子动力学模拟和体外研究探索BDE-209对神经退行性疾病的毒理学影响
items.summaryZh: 该研究采用网络毒理学、分子对接、分子动力学模拟和PC12细胞体外实验，探讨持久性阻燃剂BDE-209与帕金森病、阿尔茨海默病和肌萎缩侧索硬化的潜在关联。分析识别出90个共有靶点，主要涉及脂质代谢、氧化应激和炎症通路；分子对接提示FKBP12-mTOR复合物为候选结合系统，MD模拟支持该构象稳定。细胞实验中，BDE-209在10 μM升高p-mTOR、20 μM升高IL-1β，雷帕霉素可减弱p-mTOR反应，但IL-1β诱导是否依赖mTOR尚未确定；40 μM时细胞活力下降，可能存在沉淀或聚集干扰。研究提示mTOR失调可能参与BDE-209的细胞反应，但直接结合、慢性暴露和体内疾病相关性仍需验证。
items.insight: 该研究将环境毒理学与ALS等神经退行性疾病机制联系起来，提出BDE-209可能通过mTOR信号通路产生影响，为ALS环境风险因素研究提供了可检验的候选机制。尽管目前仅为体外细胞实验，但mTOR通路在ALS中已有一定研究基础，值得关注后续是否开展体内验证和慢性暴露研究。

items.abstractZh: 十溴二苯醚（BDE-209）是一种与神经毒性相关的持久性阻燃剂，但其与神经退行性疾病的潜在联系仍不清楚。我们整合了网络毒理学、分子对接、分子动力学（MD）模拟和体外实验，研究BDE-209在帕金森病（PD）、阿尔茨海默病（AD）和肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）中的作用。网络分析识别出90个共有靶点，富集于脂质代谢、氧化应激和炎症通路，包括IL-17和TNF信号通路。分子对接将FKBP12-mTOR复合物优先列为候选结合系统，评分为-8.6 kcal/mol。MD模拟支持预测构象的稳定性，该构象主要由涉及PHE-128和TRP-190的范德华力和疏水相互作用主导。在分化的PC12细胞中，BDE-209在10 μM时增加p-mTOR，在20 μM时增加IL-1β，且无明显细胞毒性。雷帕霉素减弱了p-mTOR反应，支持mTOR参与其中，但IL-1β诱导对mTOR的依赖性尚未确立。在40 μM时，BDE-209降低细胞活力，可能受到沉淀或聚集的混杂影响。这些发现提示mTOR失调参与BDE-209的细胞反应，但直接结合、慢性暴露和体内疾病相关性仍需进一步验证。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近整合网络毒理学与体外实验，提示持久性环境污染物BDE-209可能通过mTOR失调与ALS等神经退行性疾病相关，具有环境病因学和转化验证价值。

items.title: TBK1 overexpression reduces neuronal loss in the P497S UBQLN2 mouse model of ALS/FTD.
items.summary: Missense mutations in UBQLN2 are linked to dominant inheritance of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) which is frequently accompanied by frontotemporal dementia (FTD). The encoded UBQLN2 protein functions to maintain proteostasis, collapse of which is increasingly being realized as the cause of many neurodegenerative diseases. During investigations of our UBQLN2 mouse models of ALS/FTD, we observed a significant decline in Tank-binding kinase 1 (TBK1) protein in end-stage mice. The decline could be significant, as haploinsufficiency of TBK1 expression is linked to ALS/FTD. To determine whether the reduction in TBK1 levels is responsible for driving pathogenesis, we crossed P497S UBQLN2 transgenic (Tg) mice with BacTBK1 Tg mice that overexpress TBK1 and analyzed the progeny for signs of pathology. The analysis revealed that double transgenic mice had a significant reduction in neurodegeneration in both the brain and spinal cord (SC) compared to P497S single-Tg mice. Double immunofluorescence staining of P497S mouse tissue revealed TBK1 colocalizes with UBQLN2 aggregates in spinal motor neurons. Biochemical extraction studies of mouse brain tissue revealed increased enrichment of TBK1 along with wild type and mutant UBQLN2 proteins in detergent-insoluble material, suggesting TBK1 gets sequestered by UBQLN2 aggregates. GST-pulldown assays revealed that UBQLN2 binds directly with TBK1, but paradoxically the P497S mutation was found to reduce TBK1 binding. Turnover studies indicated that loss of UBQLN2 destabilizes TBK1, providing another route for its reduction. These findings lead us to propose that efforts directed toward increasing TBK1 expression may provide a therapeutic approach for treating ALS/FTD caused by UBQLN2 mutations.
items.titleZh: TBK1过表达可减少ALS/FTD的P497S UBQLN2小鼠模型中的神经元丢失
items.summaryZh: 该研究在P497S UBQLN2转基因ALS/FTD小鼠模型中发现，终末期小鼠TBK1蛋白水平显著下降。通过将P497S UBQLN2小鼠与过表达TBK1的BacTBK1小鼠杂交，双转基因子代在脑和脊髓中的神经退行性变显著减少。机制上，TBK1与UBQLN2聚集体共定位并被隔离于去垢剂不溶性组分中；UBQLN2与TBK1直接结合，但P497S突变降低该结合；UBQLN2缺失导致TBK1不稳定。作者据此提出，增加TBK1表达可能成为UBQLN2突变所致ALS/FTD的潜在治疗策略。
items.insight: 该研究将TBK1单倍剂量不足这一已知ALS/FTD遗传学证据与UBQLN2突变模型中的蛋白稳态失衡直接联系起来，提出TBK1被UBQLN2聚集体隔离并因UBQLN2功能缺失而不稳定，从而为TBK1过表达作为UBQLN2相关ALS/FTD的干预方向提供了临床前概念验证。对关注蛋白稳态、聚集体清除和遗传学交叉调控的ALS研究者而言，该工作提示TBK1水平可能是一个可调节的节点，值得在更多模型和细胞类型中验证。

items.abstractZh: UBQLN2的错义突变与肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）的显性遗传相关，且常伴有额颞叶痴呆（FTD）。所编码的UBQLN2蛋白功能在于维持蛋白稳态，而蛋白稳态的崩溃正日益被认为是许多神经退行性疾病的病因。在我们对ALS/FTD的UBQLN2小鼠模型进行研究期间，我们观察到终末期小鼠中Tank结合激酶1（TBK1）蛋白显著下降。这种下降可能具有重要意义，因为TBK1表达的单倍剂量不足与ALS/FTD相关。为确定TBK1水平的降低是否驱动了发病机制，我们将P497S UBQLN2转基因（Tg）小鼠与过表达TBK1的BacTBK1 Tg小鼠杂交，并分析子代是否存在病理迹象。分析显示，与P497S单转基因小鼠相比，双转基因小鼠在脑和脊髓（SC）中的神经退行性变均显著减少。对P497S小鼠组织的双重免疫荧光染色显示，TBK1与脊髓运动神经元中的UBQLN2聚集体共定位。对小鼠脑组织的生化提取研究显示，TBK1与野生型和突变型UBQLN2蛋白在去垢剂不溶性物质中的富集增加，提示TBK1被UBQLN2聚集体隔离。GST下拉实验显示UBQLN2与TBK1直接结合，但矛盾的是，P497S突变被发现会降低TBK1的结合。周转研究表明，UBQLN2的缺失会使TBK1不稳定，为其减少提供了另一条途径。这些发现使我们提出，旨在增加TBK1表达的努力可能为治疗由UBQLN2突变引起的ALS/FTD提供一种治疗途径。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究在2026年发表，利用UBQLN2突变ALS/FTD小鼠模型证明过表达TBK1可减少神经元丢失，为TBK1相关遗传通路提供了新的转化依据。

items.title: Cellular senescence is an early feature and therapeutic target in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis TDP-43 Q331K mice.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disorder characterized by progressive motor neuron degeneration in the motor cortex and spinal cord. Aging is a key risk factor for ALS, and cellular senescence - a hallmark of aging marked by irreversible cell-cycle arrest and a pro-inflammatory senescence-associated secretory phenotype - has been implicated in neurodegeneration, yet its role in ALS progression remains incompletely understood. Here, we show that molecular markers of cellular senescence emerge in the motor cortex and spinal cord alongside declines in neural and neuromuscular function in TDP-43 Q331K ALS mice, supporting senescence as an early feature of ALS pathology. To test whether reduced senescence ameliorates ALS pathology, we evaluated longitudinal senolytic treatment with dasatinib and quercetin (D&Q) in TDP-43 Q331K mice. D&Q treatment improved motor behavior, neuromuscular function, and reduced axonal damage as measured by plasma neurofilament light chain, accompanied by robust improvements in motor cortex excitability and preservation of layer V neuron counts. At the cellular level, cortical microglia were implicated as a potential mediator of senolytic benefits based on reduced microglial TDP-43 burden and senescence markers. Together, these findings identify cellular senescence as an early, disease-relevant, and modifiable feature of ALS pathology.
items.titleZh: 细胞衰老是肌萎缩侧索硬化TDP-43 Q331K小鼠的早期特征及治疗靶点
items.summaryZh: 该研究在TDP-43 Q331K ALS小鼠模型中发现，细胞衰老标志物在运动皮层和脊髓中早期出现，与神经功能下降同步。使用达沙替尼和槲皮素进行衰老细胞清除治疗，可改善运动行为、神经肌肉功能和运动皮层兴奋性，减少轴突损伤，并保留皮层V层神经元。小胶质细胞可能是治疗获益的关键介导者。研究提示细胞衰老是ALS早期可干预的病理特征。
items.insight: 这项研究将细胞衰老定位为ALS的早期可修饰特征，并提供了衰老细胞清除药物在遗传性ALS小鼠模型中的多维度获益证据，包括行为学、电生理、神经影像和病理指标。对于ALS研究者而言，它提示衰老相关机制可能是独立于TDP-43蛋白聚集的上游或并行通路，且达沙替尼和槲皮素作为已上市药物，具有较高的临床转化潜力。小胶质细胞作为介导者，也为神经炎症干预提供了新视角。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种致死性神经退行性疾病，以运动皮层和脊髓中运动神经元的进行性退变为特征。衰老是ALS的关键危险因素，而细胞衰老——一种以不可逆细胞周期停滞和促炎性衰老相关分泌表型为标志的衰老特征——已被认为与神经退行性变有关，但其在ALS进展中的作用仍不完全清楚。在此，我们显示，在TDP-43 Q331K ALS小鼠中，细胞衰老的分子标志物与神经及神经肌肉功能下降同时出现在运动皮层和脊髓中，支持衰老是ALS病理的早期特征。为检验减少衰老是否能改善ALS病理，我们在TDP-43 Q331K小鼠中评估了达沙替尼和槲皮素（D&Q）的纵向衰老细胞清除治疗。D&Q治疗改善了运动行为、神经肌肉功能，并减少了通过血浆神经丝轻链测得的轴突损伤，同时伴有运动皮层兴奋性的显著改善和V层神经元计数的保留。在细胞水平上，基于小胶质细胞TDP-43负荷和衰老标志物的减少，皮层小胶质细胞被认为是衰老细胞清除获益的潜在介导者。总之，这些发现将细胞衰老确定为ALS病理的一个早期、疾病相关且可修饰的特征。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究于2026年发表，首次在TDP-43 Q331K ALS小鼠中系统证明细胞衰老是早期可修饰特征，并显示衰老细胞清除治疗可改善多维度病理表型，具有明确的ALS相关性和转化价值。

items.title: Selective neuroprotection in the ALS-FTD spectrum: Mechanisms of neuronal resilience and translational perspectives.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is increasingly recognized as part of a broader clinico-pathological continuum encompassing frontotemporal dementia (FTD). Despite progressive degeneration across motor and cognitive neural systems associated with TDP-43 pathology, specific neuronal populations-including the oculomotor and abducens nuclei, Onuf's nucleus, and sensory dorsal column pathways-remain relatively preserved. Selectively preserved neuronal structures in ALS have largely been described as isolated neuropathological observations without sufficient mechanistic integration. This review aims to synthesize candidate intrinsic and microenvironmental mechanisms that may contribute to selective neuronal preservation and propose a translational framework for understanding neuronal resilience in the ALS-FTD spectrum. We conducted a comprehensive critical review of the literature addressing selective neuronal vulnerability and resistance in ALS-FTD, integrating comparative observations from related neurodegenerative and neuromuscular disorders. Particular emphasis was placed on candidate mechanisms associated with neuronal resilience, including Nrf2/ARE signaling, calcium homeostasis, glutamatergic receptor composition, glial-mediated neurotrophic support, and emerging transcriptomic evidence relevant to selective neuronal vulnerability. Selective preservation of specific neuronal populations represents a distinctive biological characteristic of the ALS-FTD spectrum. Current evidence suggests that enhanced antioxidant defense, tightly regulated intracellular calcium dynamics, protective microenvironmental interactions, and other stress-response pathways may collectively contribute to resistance against TDP-43 proteinopathy. These findings may provide a mechanistic framework for understanding selective neuronal resilience and suggest potential avenues for future neuroprotective therapeutic development. Integrating mechanisms of selective neuroprotection with translational neurobiological perspectives may provide a conceptual framework for ALS research. Leveraging preserved neural systems may not only inform biologically grounded supportive care strategies but also help identify mechanistically relevant targets for future disease-modifying interventions.
items.titleZh: ALS-FTD谱系中的选择性神经保护：神经元韧性机制与转化前景
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇综述，系统梳理了ALS-FTD谱系中为何部分神经元（如动眼神经核、Onuf核、感觉背柱通路）能在TDP-43病理背景下相对保留。文章整合了Nrf2/ARE抗氧化通路、钙稳态、谷氨酸受体组成、胶质细胞营养支持及转录组学等候选机制，提出选择性神经元韧性可能是多因素共同作用的结果，并讨论了利用这些保留系统指导支持性照护和寻找疾病修饰靶点的转化思路。
items.insight: 该综述将ALS中长期以来被视为孤立现象的“选择性神经元保留”提升为可机制化研究的核心问题，并整合了抗氧化、钙调控、胶质微环境和转录组等多层次证据。对ALS研究者而言，其价值在于提示：理解为何某些神经元能抵抗TDP-43毒性，可能比单纯追问为何运动神经元死亡更能揭示内源性保护通路，并为神经保护治疗提供新的靶点方向。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）日益被认为是一个更广泛的临床-病理连续谱的一部分，该连续谱涵盖额颞叶痴呆（FTD）。尽管与TDP-43病理相关的运动与认知神经系统存在进行性变性，特定神经元群体——包括动眼神经核和展神经核、Onuf核以及感觉背柱通路——仍相对保留。ALS中选择性保留的神经元结构在很大程度上被描述为孤立的神经病理学观察，缺乏充分的机制整合。本综述旨在综合可能促成选择性神经元保留的候选内在与微环境机制，并提出一个用于理解ALS-FTD谱系中神经元韧性的转化框架。我们对涉及ALS-FTD中选择性神经元易感性与抵抗性的文献进行了全面的批判性综述，并整合了来自相关神经退行性疾病和神经肌肉疾病中的比较观察。特别关注与神经元韧性相关的候选机制，包括Nrf2/ARE信号通路、钙稳态、谷氨酸能受体组成、胶质细胞介导的神经营养支持，以及与选择性神经元易感性相关的新兴转录组学证据。特定神经元群体的选择性保留是ALS-FTD谱系的一个独特生物学特征。当前证据提示，增强的抗氧化防御、严格调控的细胞内钙动态、保护性微环境相互作用以及其他应激反应通路可能共同促成对TDP-43蛋白病的抵抗。这些发现可能为理解选择性神经元韧性提供机制框架，并为未来神经保护治疗开发提示潜在途径。将选择性神经保护机制与转化神经生物学视角相整合，可能为ALS研究提供一个概念框架。利用保留的神经系统不仅可能为有生物学依据的支持性照护策略提供信息，还可能有助于识别未来疾病修饰干预的机制相关靶点。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述新近整合了ALS-FTD谱系中选择性神经元韧性的多机制证据，为理解TDP-43蛋白病中选择性易感性与神经保护靶点提供了转化导向的概念框架。

items.title: Motor coordination and behavioural deficits in a mouse model of KMT2B-related dystonia.
items.summary: Pathogenic variants in KMT2B cause early-onset dystonia, but a mouse model that has undergone comprehensive, dystonia-oriented phenotyping is lacking. We conducted detailed phenotyping on heterozygous Kmt2b constitutive knockout mice and wild-type littermates, assessing growth, neurobehavioural traits, motor coordination, sensorimotor gating, social behaviour and metabolic parameters, combined with striatal RNA sequencing. Kmt2b knockout mice of both sexes were viable but significantly smaller and lighter than littermate controls. Knockouts were hyperlocomotive in the open field and showed approximately two-fold larger acoustic startle responses; unexpectedly, prepulse inhibition was enhanced rather than reduced at all prepulse intensities. On the balance beam, knockouts crossed more slowly and paused more frequently; female knockouts also paused more on the ladder rung task. Frame-by-frame video analysis revealed a claw-like hindpaw posture characterized by abnormal inward flexion of the digits. Knockout mice spent less time investigating a novel conspecific, while social recognition memory remained intact. Striatal RNA sequencing confirmed reduction of Kmt2b transcript to approximately half of control levels and identified 177 differentially expressed genes, including Maob, encoding monoamine oxidase B; gene set enrichment analysis implicated neurodevelopmental, glial and mitochondrial processes. Nociception, vision, body-weight-adjusted grip strength, and clinical chemistry and haematological measures were largely unaffected. Heterozygous Kmt2b knockout mice show hyperlocomotion, altered sensorimotor gating, impaired motor coordination with dystonic-like paw posturing and reduced sociability, alongside a striatal transcriptomic signature implicating neurodevelopmental processes. The model mirrors aspects of human KMT2B-related dystonia and provides a platform for mechanistic study; environmental or pharmacological challenge may be needed to unmask overt dystonic features.
items.titleZh: KMT2B相关肌张力障碍小鼠模型中的运动协调与行为缺陷
items.summaryZh: 该研究对杂合Kmt2b敲除小鼠进行了全面的行为与转录组表型分析，发现其存在活动过度、惊跳反应增强、前脉冲抑制反常增强、运动协调障碍、肌张力障碍样后爪姿势及社交能力下降，纹状体转录组提示神经发育、胶质和线粒体过程异常。该模型部分再现了人类KMT2B相关肌张力障碍特征，但未出现明显自发性肌张力障碍，提示可能需要额外挑战才能完全显现表型。
items.insight: KMT2B相关肌张力障碍与ALS同属神经退行性运动障碍，该模型提供了研究纹状体神经发育、线粒体功能和单胺代谢异常如何导致运动协调障碍的平台。其纹状体转录组中Maob等差异基因及线粒体过程富集，可能为理解ALS中运动环路选择性易损性提供参考。此外，该模型显示隐性表型需环境或药物挑战才能显现，提示ALS研究中也应关注亚临床表型和应激暴露实验设计。

items.abstractZh: KMT2B的致病性变异可导致早发性肌张力障碍，但目前尚缺乏经过全面、以肌张力障碍为导向的表型分析的小鼠模型。我们对杂合Kmt2b组成型敲除小鼠及其野生型同窝对照进行了详细表型分析，评估了生长、神经行为特征、运动协调、感觉运动门控、社会行为和代谢参数，并结合纹状体RNA测序。两种性别的Kmt2b敲除小鼠均可存活，但体型和体重显著小于同窝对照。敲除小鼠在旷场中表现出活动过度，听觉惊跳反应约增大两倍；出乎意料的是，在所有前脉冲强度下，前脉冲抑制均增强而非减弱。在平衡木上，敲除小鼠通过速度更慢、停顿更频繁；雌性敲除小鼠在梯级任务中停顿也更多。逐帧视频分析揭示了一种爪样后爪姿势，其特征为趾部异常向内弯曲。敲除小鼠探索新异同种个体的时间减少，而社会识别记忆保持完整。纹状体RNA测序证实Kmt2b转录本降至对照水平约一半，并鉴定出177个差异表达基因，包括编码单胺氧化酶B的Maob；基因集富集分析提示神经发育、胶质和线粒体过程参与其中。痛觉、视觉、体重校正后的握力以及临床化学和血液学指标基本未受影响。杂合Kmt2b敲除小鼠表现出活动过度、感觉运动门控改变、运动协调受损伴肌张力障碍样爪姿势以及社交能力下降，同时伴有提示神经发育过程的纹状体转录组特征。该模型反映了人类KMT2B相关肌张力障碍的某些方面，为机制研究提供了平台；可能需要环境或药物挑战才能揭示明显的肌张力障碍特征。
items.frontierRationale: 该新近动物模型首次对Kmt2b敲除小鼠进行全面的肌张力障碍导向表型分析，揭示了纹状体转录组中神经发育和线粒体过程异常，为ALS相关运动障碍的机制研究提供了可转化的候选平台。

items.title: Astrocyte-derived extracellular vesicle phosphorylated TDP-43 as a blood-based biomarker for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disease characterized by central nervous system (CNS) neuroglial TAR DNA-binding protein 43 (TDP-43) pathology in ∼90-95% of cases. Non-invasive biomarkers are critically needed to reduce diagnostic delay, enable patient stratification, and assess treatment efficacy in clinical trials. Astrocyte-derived extracellular vesicles (ADEVs) represent promising CNS liquid biopsy biomarkers, given astrocyte involvement in ALS pathogenesis and the ability of ADEVs to cross the blood-brain barrier and carry TDP-43. Here, we assessed the diagnostic performance of TDP-43 and its hyperphosphorylated pathological form, phospho-Ser409 (pTDP-43), quantified in ADEVs, for distinguishing ALS cases from matched healthy controls. ADEVs were immunoisolated from whole blood (n = 76) and plasma (n = 86) across three ALS biorepositories/cohorts. ADEV quality and enrichment were validated in accordance with minimal information for studies of extracellular vesicles guidelines, and protein levels were normalized by ratio to tetraspanin cluster of differentiation 81 (CD81). Diagnostic accuracy was evaluated by logistic regression and random forest models with cross-validation, adjusting for age and sex across 100 random seeds. Plasma ADEV pTDP-43/CD81 ratio best predicted ALS case status, with a mean AUC of 0.89 (95% CI: 0.75-0.99) from logistic models, corresponding to a mean sensitivity and specificity of 87% and 89%, respectively, and a mean AUC of 0.86 (95% CI: 0.82-0.90) from random forest models. Although the specificity of ADEV pTDP-43 relative to disease mimics and associations with disease progression require further investigation, these findings support its potential as a biomarker candidate for ALS and for patient stratification in TDP-43-targeted clinical trials.
items.titleZh: 星形胶质细胞来源的细胞外囊泡中磷酸化TDP-43作为肌萎缩侧索硬化症血液生物标志物
items.summaryZh: 该研究评估了星形胶质细胞来源细胞外囊泡（ADEVs）中的磷酸化TDP-43（pTDP-43）作为ALS血液生物标志物的诊断性能。在三个ALS队列的全血和血浆样本中，血浆ADEV pTDP-43/CD81比值在区分ALS与健康对照时表现最佳，逻辑回归模型平均AUC达0.89，灵敏度87%，特异度89%。研究提示该指标有望用于ALS诊断和TDP-43靶向试验的患者分层，但其对疾病模拟者的特异性及与疾病进展的关联仍需进一步验证。
items.insight: 这项研究为ALS提供了一种基于血液的CNS来源液体活检策略，直接检测星形胶质细胞来源囊泡中的病理形式TDP-43，有望解决ALS诊断延迟和临床试验患者分层两大瓶颈。其跨血脑屏障的ADEV载体设计使其具备转化为临床可用血液检测的潜力，尤其适用于TDP-43靶向治疗的入组筛选和药效监测。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）是一种致死性神经退行性疾病，约90-95%的病例以中枢神经系统（CNS）神经胶质细胞中TAR DNA结合蛋白43（TDP-43）病理为特征。目前迫切需要非侵入性生物标志物以减少诊断延迟、实现患者分层并评估临床试验中的治疗效果。鉴于星形胶质细胞参与ALS发病机制，且星形胶质细胞来源的细胞外囊泡（ADEVs）能够穿越血脑屏障并携带TDP-43，ADEVs代表有前景的CNS液体活检生物标志物。在此，我们评估了在ADEVs中定量的TDP-43及其过度磷酸化病理形式——磷酸化Ser409（pTDP-43）——在区分ALS病例与匹配健康对照中的诊断性能。ADEVs从全血（n=76）和血浆（n=86）中免疫分离，涵盖三个ALS生物样本库/队列。ADEV质量和富集度按照细胞外囊泡研究最低信息指南进行验证，蛋白质水平通过四跨膜蛋白分化簇81（CD81）的比值进行归一化。诊断准确性通过逻辑回归和随机森林模型结合交叉验证进行评估，并在100个随机种子中调整年龄和性别。血浆ADEV pTDP-43/CD81比值最能预测ALS病例状态，逻辑回归模型的平均AUC为0.89（95% CI：0.75-0.99），对应平均灵敏度和特异度分别为87%和89%，随机森林模型的平均AUC为0.86（95% CI：0.82-0.90）。尽管ADEV pTDP-43相对于疾病模拟者的特异性以及与疾病进展的关联需要进一步研究，这些发现支持其作为ALS生物标志物候选物以及用于TDP-43靶向临床试验中患者分层的潜力。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近提出星形胶质细胞来源细胞外囊泡中的磷酸化TDP-43作为ALS血液生物标志物，直接关联TDP-43病理核心机制，并展示出用于TDP-43靶向临床试验患者分层的转化价值。

items.title: Beyond Histamine Blockade: Clemastine Fumarate as a Promoter of Myelin Regeneration, Inflammatory Regulation, and Neuroimmune Modulation in CNS Disorders.
items.summary: Clemastine fumarate, a first-generation H1 antihistamine, has emerged as a promising candidate for drug repurposing in neurodegenerative and neuropsychiatric disorders owing to its ability to cross the blood-brain barrier and interact with multiple central nervous system targets. Experimental studies indicate that clemastine promotes remyelination by stimulating the differentiation of oligodendrocyte precursor cells into mature, myelin-producing oligodendrocytes, thereby restoring myelin integrity and improving axonal function in experimental models. In addition to its remyelinating properties, preclinical evidence suggests that clemastine may attenuate neuroinflammation by modulating microglial activation and suppressing pro-inflammatory signalling pathways. These effects have been associated with improved structural and functional outcomes in experimental models of multiple sclerosis, Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, spinal cord injury, stroke, and several neuropsychiatric disorders. Mechanistically, clemastine primarily acts through muscarinic M1 receptor antagonism to promotes remyelination, while additional pathways including PI3K/Akt, ERK1/2, autophagy-related signalling, inflammasome modulation, and sigma-1 receptor signalling have been proposed based on experimental evidence but remain incompletely understood and require further mechanistic validation. Among the neurological disorders investigated multiple sclerosis currently has the strongest clinical evidence with early clinical trials demonstrating modest remyelinating activity. In contrast, evidence supporting the use of clemastine in other neurological disorders remains largely confined to preclinical studies. Several translational challenges also remain unresolved including dose optimisation, treatment timing, long-term safety, sedative and anticholinergic adverse effects, and patient selection. Future research should focus on refining pharmacokinetic properties, optimising dosing strategies, evaluating rational combination therapies, and identifying predictive biomarkers to facilitate clinical translation. Although current evidence highlights the therapeutic potential of clemastine fumarate, its application beyond multiple sclerosis remains investigational and will require rigorous mechanistic studies together with well-designed clinical trials before broader clinical use can be established.

items.titleZh: 超越组胺阻断：富马酸氯马斯汀作为中枢神经系统疾病中髓鞘再生、炎症调控和神经免疫调节的促进剂
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇关于富马酸氯马斯汀（第一代H1抗组胺药）用于中枢神经系统疾病药物重定位的综述。文章指出，该药可通过毒蕈碱M1受体拮抗等机制促进髓鞘再生、调节神经炎症，在包括肌萎缩侧索硬化在内的多种疾病的实验模型中显示出改善结构和功能结局的潜力。目前，多发性硬化的临床证据最强，而包括ALS在内的其他疾病证据仍主要来自临床前研究。文章强调剂量优化、治疗时机、长期安全性及患者选择等转化挑战尚未解决，其在多发性硬化之外的应用仍属研究性质。
items.insight: 对ALS研究者而言，本文的价值在于系统梳理了氯马斯汀这一可穿过血脑屏障的老药在神经退行性疾病中的多靶点作用（髓鞘再生、小胶质细胞调节、炎症通路抑制），并明确指出现有ALS相关证据仅停留在临床前阶段。这为评估其作为ALS联合治疗或神经炎症调控候选药物提供了机制框架，同时提示需关注剂量、镇静及抗胆碱能副作用等转化障碍。

items.abstractZh: 富马酸氯马斯汀是一种第一代H1抗组胺药，因其能够穿过血脑屏障并与多个中枢神经系统靶点相互作用，已成为神经退行性疾病和神经精神疾病药物重定位的有前景候选药物。实验研究表明，氯马斯汀通过刺激少突胶质前体细胞分化为成熟的、产生髓鞘的少突胶质细胞来促进髓鞘再生，从而在实验模型中恢复髓鞘完整性并改善轴突功能。除髓鞘再生特性外，临床前证据提示氯马斯汀可能通过调节小胶质细胞活化和抑制促炎信号通路来减轻神经炎症。这些效应与多发性硬化、阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、肌萎缩侧索硬化、脊髓损伤、卒中和若干神经精神疾病的实验模型中结构和功能结局的改善相关。在机制上，氯马斯汀主要通过毒蕈碱M1受体拮抗作用促进髓鞘再生，而包括PI3K/Akt、ERK1/2、自噬相关信号、炎症小体调节和sigma-1受体信号在内的其他通路已基于实验证据被提出，但仍未完全阐明，需要进一步的机制验证。在所研究的神经系统疾病中，多发性硬化目前拥有最强的临床证据，早期临床试验显示其具有适度的髓鞘再生活性。相比之下，支持氯马斯汀用于其他神经系统疾病的证据仍主要局限于临床前研究。若干转化挑战仍未解决，包括剂量优化、治疗时机、长期安全性、镇静和抗胆碱能不良反应以及患者选择。未来研究应侧重于改进药代动力学特性、优化给药策略、评估合理的联合治疗以及识别预测性生物标志物以促进临床转化。尽管当前证据凸显了富马酸氯马斯汀的治疗潜力，但其在多发性硬化之外的应用仍处于研究阶段，在能够确立更广泛的临床使用之前，需要严格的机制研究和精心设计的临床试验。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述新近整合了氯马斯汀在ALS等中枢神经系统疾病中促髓鞘再生与神经免疫调节的临床前证据，并明确指出其临床转化尚需机制验证和规范试验，对ALS药物重定位具有参考价值。

items.title: N-terminal proVGF modifications related to Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis.
items.summary: Objective : Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder characterized by motor dysfunction, for which effective therapies and early diagnostic biomarkers remain limited. This study comprehensively investigated ALS-associated alterations in the N-terminal region of the proVGF precursor protein, evaluating their potential as novel diagnostic and prognostic biomarkers and exploring their precise correlations with clinical severity and plasma neurofilament light chain (NfL), an established indicator of neuroaxonal injury. Methods : N-terminal proVGF levels were quantified using a custom immunoassay using human plasma and lymphocytes as well as motor neuron-like NSC-34 cells subjected to oxidative stress. The clinical cohort comprised 49 ALS patients (28 early-stage, 21 advanced-stage) and 50 age-matched healthy controls. To assess disease specificity, plasma from patients with Parkinson's disease (PD, n = 50), idiopathic dystonia (n = 15), and idiopathic rapid eye movement (REM) sleep behavior disorder (iRBD, n = 21) was analyzed alongside respective age-matched healthy controls (n = 26, 8, and 20). Furthermore, plasma NfL levels were measured and directly correlated with N-terminal proVGF concentrations. Results : N-terminal proVGF levels were significantly increased in both plasma and lymphocytes during the early and advanced stages of ALS. Plasma NfL levels were concomitantly elevated across all ALS patients. In advanced-stage patients, N-terminal proVGF concentrations significantly correlated with both ALSFRS-R scores and NfL levels. No significant N-terminal proVGF alterations were observed in PD, iRBD, or dystonia cohorts. Oxidative stress similarly upregulated N-terminal proVGF levels in vitro within NSC-34 cells. Conclusion : Alterations of the N-terminal region of proVGF are specific to ALS, highlighting their dual value as diagnostic and prognostic biomarkers.
items.titleZh: 与肌萎缩侧索硬化相关的N端proVGF修饰
items.summaryZh: 该研究检测了ALS患者血浆和淋巴细胞中proVGF前体蛋白N端区域的水平，发现其在ALS早期和晚期均显著升高，且晚期患者中与疾病严重程度评分（ALSFRS-R）和神经轴突损伤标志物NfL相关。在帕金森病、特发性肌张力障碍和iRBD患者中未观察到类似改变，提示该指标对ALS具有一定特异性。细胞实验中氧化应激也可上调该蛋白片段。
items.insight: 这项研究提出proVGF N端区域改变作为ALS候选生物标志物，其价值在于同时具备诊断和预后潜力，并与已建立的NfL指标相关。对于ALS研究者而言，值得跟踪的是该指标在早期诊断中的敏感性、与疾病进展的纵向关联，以及在更大规模、多中心队列中的可重复性。此外，该研究提示氧化应激可能驱动proVGF N端修饰，为机制研究提供了线索。

items.abstractZh: 目的：肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种以运动功能障碍为特征的进行性神经退行性疾病，目前有效疗法和早期诊断生物标志物仍然有限。本研究全面探究了ALS相关的proVGF前体蛋白N端区域改变，评估其作为新型诊断和预后生物标志物的潜力，并探索其与临床严重程度及血浆神经丝轻链（NfL，一种公认的神经轴突损伤指标）的精确相关性。方法：使用定制免疫分析法，在人血浆和淋巴细胞以及暴露于氧化应激的运动神经元样NSC-34细胞中定量N端proVGF水平。临床队列包括49例ALS患者（28例早期，21例晚期）和50例年龄匹配的健康对照。为评估疾病特异性，还分析了帕金森病（PD，n=50）、特发性肌张力障碍（n=15）和特发性快速眼动（REM）睡眠行为障碍（iRBD，n=21）患者的血浆，以及各自年龄匹配的健康对照（n=26、8和20）。此外，测量了血浆NfL水平，并直接与N端proVGF浓度进行相关性分析。结果：在ALS早期和晚期阶段，血浆和淋巴细胞中N端proVGF水平均显著升高。所有ALS患者的血浆NfL水平同时升高。在晚期患者中，N端proVGF浓度与ALSFRS-R评分和NfL水平均显著相关。在PD、iRBD或肌张力障碍队列中未观察到显著的N端proVGF改变。氧化应激同样在体外上调了NSC-34细胞中的N端proVGF水平。结论：proVGF N端区域的改变对ALS具有特异性，突显了其作为诊断和预后生物标志物的双重价值。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近报道了proVGF N端修饰作为ALS特异性生物标志物，并与NfL及临床严重程度相关，具有诊断和预后转化潜力。

items.title: Clinical and genetic characterization of FUS -associated ALS in a tertiary cohort.
items.summary: An understanding of FUS -related ALS is becoming increasingly actionable with the emergence of targeted therapies. We retrospectively reviewed patients with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis and reported FUS variants evaluated across all Mayo Clinic sites between January 2009 and June 2026. Variants were reevaluated according to ACMG/AMP criteria, and clinical and genetic data were abstracted from medical records. The primary cohort included 12 unrelated patients with pathogenic or likely pathogenic (P/LP) FUS variants; 6 patients with variants of uncertain significance were retained descriptively. Pathogenic variants clustered in the C-terminal region, including one previously unreported likely pathogenic frameshift variant, c.1491_1494dup. Patients with pathogenic variants showed early-onset, rapidly progressive disease with frequent bulbar or respiratory onset, predominant lower motor neuron findings, and short survival. Observed phenotypes were broadly consistent with previous variant-specific reports. These findings expand variant-specific natural history data in FUS -ALS and may inform prognosis, patient stratification, and the interpretation of emerging FUS -targeted therapeutic studies.
items.titleZh: 一家三级医疗中心队列中FUS相关ALS的临床与遗传学特征
items.summaryZh: 该研究回顾了Mayo Clinic多院区17年间携带FUS变异的ALS患者，其中12例为致病/可能致病变异。这些患者多为早发、进展快、延髓或呼吸起病、下运动神经元受累为主、生存期短。研究还发现了一个此前未报告的C端移码变异。整体表型与既往变异特异性报道一致，为FUS-ALS的自然史和患者分层提供了更多数据。
items.insight: FUS-ALS正进入靶向治疗时代，而变异特异性自然史数据是患者分层、预后判断和临床试验解读的基础。该队列样本量虽小，但来自单一三级中心、随访时间长，并纳入了一个新变异，对正在设计或解读FUS靶向试验的研究者具有直接参考价值。

items.abstractZh: 随着靶向疗法的出现，对FUS相关ALS的认识正变得越来越具有可操作性。我们回顾性分析了2009年1月至2026年6月期间在Mayo Clinic所有院区接受评估的肌萎缩侧索硬化患者中报告有FUS变异的病例。根据ACMG/AMP标准对变异重新评估，并从病历中提取临床和遗传学数据。主要队列包括12例携带致病性或可能致病性（P/LP）FUS变异的无亲缘关系患者；6例携带意义未明变异的患者以描述性方式保留。致病性变异聚集于C端区域，包括一个既往未报告的可能致病性移码变异c.1491_1494dup。携带致病性变异的患者表现为早发、快速进展的疾病，常见延髓或呼吸起病，以下运动神经元表现为主，生存期短。观察到的表型与既往变异特异性报告大体一致。这些发现扩展了FUS-ALS中变异特异性自然史数据，可能有助于预后判断、患者分层以及对新出现的FUS靶向治疗研究的解读。

items.title: One-Year Clinical Course of Patients With Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Admitted to a Home Palliative Care Program: An Extension Study.
items.summary: Longer term data on ALS patients receiving home palliative care are scarce. We extended follow-up of a 6-month cohort to 12 months to characterize the trajectory of function, symptoms, vital support (noninvasive ventilation [NIV], gastrostomy, and/or tracheostomy), and advance care planning (ACP). In this prospective, single-center study, 34 consecutive ALS patients in a home palliative care program (SAMOT, Palermo) were assessed at baseline, 2, 4, 6, and 12 months, using Karnofsky, ALS Functional Rating Scale-Revised (ALSFRS-R), Edinburgh Cognitive and Behavioural ALS Screen (ECAS), Edmonton Symptom Assessment Scale (ESAS), dysphagia, vital support, and advanced care planning (ACP). Ten patients (29.4%) died over 12 months (70% at home); 26 completed the 12-month assessment. Karnofsky (34.4-27.7) and ALSFRS-R (27.1-21.7) declined significantly throughout (both p < 0.0005). Total ESAS rose from 15.7 to 23.7 (p < 0.0005); anxiety increased significantly between T4 and T12. NIV use rose from 20.6% to 50.0% (p = 0.014), while tracheostomy remained stable. Documented end-of-life decisions rose to 70.4% at 6 months but plateaued (69.2% at 12 months); no living wills were completed. Cognitive impairment on ECAS was present in about half of patients, unchanged over time. No patient was referred to or admitted to hospice. Extending follow-up beyond 6 months shows continuous functional decline and rising symptom burden, and highlights late-onset anxiety and early-plateauing ACP. Despite progressive needs, this home palliative care model appeared to support most patients at home until death over 1 year, within this single-center, non-comparative cohort.

items.abstractZh: 关于接受家庭姑息治疗的ALS患者的长期数据稀缺。我们将一个6个月队列的随访延长至12个月，以描述功能、症状、生命支持（无创通气[NIV]、胃造瘘和/或气管切开）以及预先医疗照护计划（ACP）的轨迹。在这项前瞻性、单中心研究中，34例连续入组家庭姑息治疗项目（SAMOT，巴勒莫）的ALS患者在基线、2、4、6和12个月时接受评估，使用Karnofsky评分、ALS功能评定量表修订版（ALSFRS-R）、爱丁堡认知与行为ALS筛查（ECAS）、埃德蒙顿症状评估量表（ESAS）、吞咽困难、生命支持和预先医疗照护计划（ACP）。10例患者（29.4%）在12个月内死亡（70%在家中死亡）；26例完成了12个月评估。Karnofsky评分（34.4-27.7）和ALSFRS-R（27.1-21.7）在整个期间显著下降（均p < 0.0005）。ESAS总分从15.7升至23.7（p < 0.0005）；焦虑在T4至T12之间显著增加。NIV使用率从20.6%升至50.0%（p = 0.014），而气管切开保持稳定。记录的临终决策在6个月时升至70.4%，但随后趋于平稳（12个月时为69.2%）；无生前预嘱完成。ECAS认知障碍约见于半数患者，随时间未变化。无患者被转诊至或入住临终关怀机构。将随访延长至6个月以上显示功能持续下降和症状负担加重，并突出显示了迟发性焦虑和ACP早期趋于平稳。尽管需求逐渐加重，在这一单中心、非对照队列中，该家庭姑息治疗模式似乎在1年内支持大多数患者在家中直至死亡。

items.title: Place and cause of death among people with chronic neurological diseases in Munich: a population-based study using death certificates.
items.summary: Access to palliative care is often delayed and fragmented for patients with chronic neurological diseases. This study aimed to characterize the place and cause of death among individuals with chronic neurological diseases to help identify potential gaps in palliative care provision. In this cross-sectional study, all death certificates from the city of Munich, Germany (2020-2023) were reviewed. Cases were included if malignant brain tumours, amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) or other motor neuron diseases, Parkinson's disease (PD), multiple sclerosis (MS) or other neurodegenerative or neuromuscular diseases were recorded as the cause of death or as a comorbidity. Of 60,357 deaths, 2,536 individuals (4.2%) had at least one chronic neurological disease. The most common place of death was the hospital (43.8%), followed by nursing homes (25.9%) and the private home (25.0%), with variations among disease subgroups. Overall, the neurological disease was recorded as the immediate or underlying cause of death in 57.3% of cases, while in the remaining cases it was documented as a comorbidity, reflecting its presence without formal causal attribution to death. This population-level analysis provides insight into the place and circumstances of death for a large cohort of patients with chronic neurological diseases in a major German metropolitan area and highlights substantial heterogeneity in end-of-life trajectories. The findings indicate that mortality statistics based on death certificates reflect structural limitations in cause-of-death attribution. Nevertheless, place of death remains a robust indicator, showing high hospital utilization and limited hospice use across most diagnostic groups, underscoring potential gaps in goal-concordant care.
items.titleZh: 慕尼黑慢性神经系统疾病患者的死亡地点与死因：一项基于死亡证明的人群研究
items.summaryZh: 该研究回顾了德国慕尼黑2020至2023年全部死亡证明，发现60,357例死亡中有2,536例（4.2%）患有慢性神经系统疾病，包括ALS、运动神经元病、帕金森病、多发性硬化等。这些患者最常见的死亡地点是医院（43.8%），其次为养老院（25.9%）和家中（25.0%）。仅57.3%的病例将神经系统疾病列为直接或根本死因，其余仅作为合并症记录。研究提示，死亡证明对死因的归因存在结构性局限，但死亡地点数据较可靠，显示医院使用率高、临终关怀使用有限，可能反映姑息与临终照护供给不足。
items.insight: 对ALS研究者而言，这项研究提供了以人群为基础的临终照护利用数据，提示ALS及其他运动神经元病患者在生命终末期高度依赖医院，而临终关怀与居家/安宁疗护使用有限。这有助于识别临床照护路径中的缺口，并为改善ALS患者目标一致性照护、提前转介姑息治疗提供依据。同时，研究也提醒基于死亡证明的ALS死因统计可能低估疾病负担，需谨慎解读流行病学数据。

items.abstractZh: 慢性神经系统疾病患者获得姑息治疗的机会往往延迟且碎片化。本研究旨在描述慢性神经系统疾病患者的死亡地点与死因特征，以帮助识别姑息治疗供给中的潜在缺口。在这项横断面研究中，研究者回顾了德国慕尼黑市2020年至2023年的全部死亡证明。若死亡证明中将恶性脑肿瘤、肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）或其他运动神经元病、帕金森病（PD）、多发性硬化（MS）或其他神经退行性或神经肌肉疾病记录为死因或合并症，则该病例被纳入。在60,357例死亡中，2,536人（4.2%）至少患有一种慢性神经系统疾病。最常见的死亡地点为医院（43.8%），其次为养老院（25.9%）和私人住所（25.0%），且各疾病亚组之间存在差异。总体而言，57.3%的病例将神经系统疾病记录为直接死因或根本死因，其余病例则记录为合并症，反映其存在但未被正式归因于死亡。这项人群层面的分析为了解德国一座大都市地区一大群慢性神经系统疾病患者的死亡地点与死亡情境提供了洞见，并凸显了临终轨迹的显著异质性。研究结果提示，基于死亡证明的死亡统计反映了死因归因方面的结构性局限。尽管如此，死亡地点仍是一个稳健的指标，显示大多数诊断分组中医院使用率高而临终关怀机构使用有限，凸显了与患者目标一致的照护可能存在缺口。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于2020至2023年慕尼黑全市死亡证明，新近且大规模地揭示了ALS等慢性神经系统疾病患者临终照护中医院使用率高、临终关怀不足的转化照护缺口。

items.title: SOD1 co-pathologies in the brain: insights from neuropathological evidence and implications.
items.summary: Superoxide dismutase 1 (SOD1), originally regarded as an antioxidant enzyme, is now recognized as a multifunctional protein whose conformational instability and aggregation contribute to neurodegeneration. The emerging evidence suggests that SOD1 pathology extends beyond amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, supporting a role in multiple neurodegenerative diseases. This review summarizes current neuropathological evidence of SOD1 co-pathologies in the human brain, with particular emphasis on its associations with TAR DNA-binding protein 43 (TDP-43), tau, alpha-synuclein, amyloid-β, and other aggregation-prone proteins. We examine the distribution of pathological SOD1 species across neurodegenerative diseases, their coexistence in affected brain regions, and potential mechanisms underlying these interactions, including oxidative stress, impaired proteostasis, aberrant phase separation, and cross-seeding. We also discuss emerging observations of SOD1 pathology in neurological conditions beyond classical neurodegenerative diseases, raising the possibility that SOD1 misfolding represents a broader cellular response to neuronal injury. Collectively, the available evidence supports a shift from viewing SOD1 as a disease-specific protein to considering it a potential participant in interconnected proteopathic networks. Although the functional significance of SOD1 co-pathologies remains incompletely understood, elucidating the molecular basis of aggregation may provide new insights into disease onset and progression, improving our understanding of neurodegenerative mechanisms, and facilitating the development of biomarkers and the identification of therapeutic targets across diverse proteinopathies.
items.titleZh: 脑内SOD1共病理：神经病理学证据的启示及其意义
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述汇总了人脑神经病理学证据，指出SOD1异常聚集不仅见于ALS，还常与TDP-43、tau、α-突触核蛋白、淀粉样蛋白β等病理共存，提示SOD1可能参与更广泛的蛋白质病变网络。文章讨论了氧化应激、蛋白质稳态受损、异常相分离和交叉播种等可能机制，并认为SOD1错误折叠可能是神经元损伤的普遍反应之一。
items.insight: 该综述将SOD1从传统ALS致病蛋白重新定位为多种神经退行性疾病共有的“共病理”因子，提示ALS研究需关注SOD1与TDP-43等病理的交互。对ALS领域而言，这可能影响生物标志物开发策略（如联合检测多种蛋白病理）和治疗靶点选择（如针对蛋白质稳态网络而非单一蛋白），并推动重新审视SOD1在散发性ALS及ALS-额颞叶痴呆谱系中的作用。

items.abstractZh: 超氧化物歧化酶1（SOD1）最初被认为是一种抗氧化酶，现已被认识到是一种多功能蛋白，其构象不稳定性和聚集促进神经退行性变。新出现的证据表明，SOD1病理不仅限于肌萎缩侧索硬化，还支持其在多种神经退行性疾病中发挥作用。本综述总结了当前关于人脑中SOD1共病理的神经病理学证据，特别强调其与TAR DNA结合蛋白43（TDP-43）、tau、α-突触核蛋白、淀粉样蛋白β及其他易聚集蛋白的关联。我们检查了病理性SOD1种类在神经退行性疾病中的分布、其在受累脑区中的共存情况，以及这些相互作用背后的潜在机制，包括氧化应激、蛋白质稳态受损、异常相分离和交叉播种。我们还讨论了在经典神经退行性疾病之外的其他神经系统疾病中SOD1病理的新观察，提出SOD1错误折叠可能代表对神经元损伤的更广泛细胞反应的可能性。总体而言，现有证据支持从将SOD1视为疾病特异性蛋白转向将其视为相互关联的蛋白质病变网络中的潜在参与者。尽管SOD1共病理的功能意义仍不完全清楚，但阐明聚集的分子基础可能为疾病发生和进展提供新见解，增进我们对神经退行性机制的理解，并促进跨多种蛋白质病变的生物标志物开发和治疗靶点识别。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述基于最新神经病理学证据，提出SOD1共病理参与多种神经退行性疾病网络，对ALS相关蛋白质病变机制和生物标志物开发具有重要转化启示。

items.title: The role of neurofilament light chain and other fluid biomarkers in cerebellar ataxias.
items.summary: The genetic and phenotypic heterogeneity of hereditary ataxias complicates the design of clinical trials since each ataxia progresses at different rates. Consequently, robust biomarkers are urgently needed to monitor therapeutic efficacy and safety of potential therapeutic interventions. Neurofilament light chain has emerged as a leading candidate, serving as a sensitive pharmacodynamic biomarker of neuronal injury and treatment response in neurodegenerative disorders. This review explores the utility of neurofilament light chain across various ataxias, including polyglutamine spinocerebellar ataxias, Friedreich's ataxia, multiple system atrophy, and other genetic ataxias, such as ataxias associated with RCF1 and SPG7 genes. We synthesize evidence from recent studies that have used ultra-sensitive assays. These studies consistently demonstrate elevated neurofilament light chain levels in cerebrospinal fluid and blood, correlating with disease severity, progression and neuroimaging findings. Notably, neurofilament light chain levels rise during the presymptomatic stage in spinocerebellar ataxias, highlighting its potential for stratifying individuals for trial enrolment and tracking therapeutic effects. A treatment-induced reduction in neurofilament light chain could function as a surrogate endpoint for target engagement, analogous to its validated use in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Finally, we discuss the results of other studies conducted on other biomarkers, including glial fibrillary acidic protein, total tau and phosphorylated tau, which may reflect complementary aspects of neurodegeneration and glial activation. Glial fibrillary acidic protein may provide insights into astroglial reactivity and neuroinflammation. Similarly, alteration in total tau and phosphorylated tau levels may suggest dysfunction in neuronal cytoskeleton and axonal integrity. The review also focuses on target-engagement biomarkers, including polyglutamine-expanded ataxin proteins in spinocerebellar ataxias and frataxin in Friedreich's ataxia, as critical tools to complement the ataxia biomarker toolkit. The quantification of mutant ataxin proteins provides a mechanistic readout for emerging gene-silencing or protein-lowering therapies. In parallel, the measurement of frataxin levels serves as a pharmacodynamic marker in therapeutic strategies aiming to restore frataxin expression. These target-engagement biomarkers are valuable in early phases of clinical trials, which mainly aim to demonstrate the biological activity of a treatment before later-phase trials assessing clinical efficacy. Finally, we report on somatic instability in polyglutamine spinocerebellar ataxias as an emerging and highly relevant therapeutic target. CAG repeat mosaicism is gene specific and correlates with disease progression. Integrating measures of repeat instability with neurodegenerative biomarkers could provide a comprehensive monitoring approach in clinical studies. This overview underscores the potential of fluid biomarkers, particularly neurofilament light chain, in accelerating therapeutic development for hereditary ataxias.
